data.tombstone: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Landscape after Ni Zan (四季山水圖冊), 1684. Zha Shibiao (Chinese, 1615–1698). Album leaf, ink on paper; overall: 29.9 x 39.4 cm (11 3/4 x 15 1/2 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Severance A. Millikin, 1955.37.1
data.title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Landscape after Ni Zan

inscriptions.inscription:
Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals:

Ni Zan was originally a follower of Dong Yuan.  In later years, he formed a style of his own.  The followers of Ni Zan, however, try to imitate his dryness and lightness.  This is to miss [Ni Zan].  Shibiao [seal] Shibiao. [seal, upper left edge] Erzhan.
